Product Story

Designed to make waiting feel considered.

PausePoint brings together modular seating, integrated surfaces, open access, and a soft architectural profile in one adaptable system. Designed first for healthcare waiting environments, the Myron Bench supports comfort, accessibility, and flexibility while maintaining the warmth and character of contemporary furniture. Its adaptable design also makes it suitable for hospitality, workplace, education, and other shared interiors.

About S│U & Co.
